details.cgl: Small rounded/oval budding yeast in a compact group; show narrow-neck buds, NO hyphae or germ tube. Ivory base with muted lavender bounded shadows.
details.cau: A compact cluster of oval budding yeast with narrow-neck daughter buds. No distinctive invented spikes, no hyphae obligatory. Muted cream and terracotta accents.
details.cpa: One curved chain of elongated pseudohyphal cells with visible constrictions at cell junctions and several lateral budding daughter cells. Ivory matte paint.
details.ctr: A coherent branched pseudohyphal structure with constricted cell junctions and clustered budding yeasts attached to sides, not a plant or floral ornament.
details.ckr: Several elongated oval yeast cells and a short constricted pseudohyphal chain, elongated blastoconidia, no spherical grape-only cluster.
details.cne: Two round narrow-based budding yeast cells each inside a thick opaque pale capsule boundary; capsule physically surrounds cell, not a luminous halo. No hyphae.
details.cga: Round encapsulated narrow-based budding yeast cells with a thick solid cream capsule around muted brown/lavender cell body. No invented visual distinction from C. neoformans.
details.afu: One erect conidiophore on a small septate hyphal base, flask-like terminal vesicle with phialides and parallel chains of attached greenish conidia forming a compact COLUMN on upper portion of vesicle. No loose floating spores or sparkle-cloud.
details.afl: One erect rough-walled conidiophore from a small septate hyphal base, rounded vesicle covered by radiating phialides and attached ochre/olive conidial chains. These are true attached fungal structures, no flower-petals.
details.ate: One coherent cinnamon-brown Aspergillus conidiophore with compact attached conidial chains and a few lateral accessory conidia physically connected to a small septate hyphal base. No free particles.
details.muc: Broad ribbon-like hyphae with sparse septation and irregular near-right-angle branching, plus one opaque round terminal sporangium on a simple erect stalk. Gray/ivory matte organism, not translucent cotton-cloud.
details.pji: A compact group of round-to-cup shaped cyst/asci with several clear internal bodies in a limited cutaway, not an ordinary budding yeast or hyphal mold. No clinical lungs in this pathogen artwork.
details.hca: One opaque macrophage cutaway containing multiple small intracellular oval narrow-based budding yeasts. Organisms enclosed within macrophage, no free surrounding dots or imaginary capsule.
details.coc: One large thick-walled tissue spherule cutaway containing numerous discrete round endospores fully within its cavity. Coccidioides tissue form is NOT budding yeast, no hyphae or flower ornament.
details.bla: One round thick-walled yeast mother cell with a broad-based attached bud; broad connecting neck unmistakable, opaque ivory/ochre wall.
details.sss: A slender mold conidiophore with attached small oval conidia in a rosette arrangement at the tip, supported by sparse septate hyphae. Rosette is actual attached conidia, not flower petals; no loose spores.
details.tma: A small compact group of oval/elongated yeast-like cells dividing by a central transverse septum, not narrow-based budding. Matte muted terracotta/cream.
details.der: One compact septate hyphal structure with a few attached conidia of a plausible dermatophyte morphology, no composite collage pretending all dermatophytes have one diagnostic conidial shape.
details.mal: A compact touching group of round budding yeast cells and several short curved hyphal segments (spaghetti/meatball microscopy pattern), all medical structures, no decorative scatter.
details.fus: One coherent slender septate hypha with phialide and a few attached curved multiseptate sickle/canoe-shaped macroconidia; muted ivory and mauve, no fungal mushroom cap.
details.scedosporium-apiospermum: One compact septate hyphal/conidiophore structure with single oval annelloconidia attached at tips; neutral gray/tan matte fills, no basally ballooned Lomentospora-specific structure.
details.lpr: One compact septate hyphal structure with a few flask-shaped annellides noticeably swollen at their bases and attached conidia at narrowed tips. Gray-olive matte palette.
details.pfa: A single ordinary sized red blood cell with two delicate intracellular ring forms, plus one adjacent crescent/banana-shaped gametocyte. No decorative surrounding dots; pigment is attached intracellular material.
details.pvo: One enlarged erythrocyte containing a single amoeboid trophozoite and fine Schuffner stippling INSIDE the red blood cell. The intracellular dots are clinical morphology, not outside ornament.
details.pma: One red blood cell with a broad dark band-form trophozoite across its inside, sober crisp cutaway, no floating spores.
details.pkn: One red blood cell with a malariae-like intracellular band trophozoite; no fake feature claiming microscopy reliably distinguishes P. knowlesi from P. malariae.
details.tgo: One compact cluster of slender crescent-shaped tachyzoites, pointed anterior and rounded posterior with one subtle central nucleus each. Teal/ivory bounded shadows; no fantasy eyes.
details.ehi: One amoeboid trophozoite with one plausible nucleus and two engulfed red blood cells within cytoplasm. Pseudopod is part of the amoeba, no arms/face.
details.cry: One small round thick-walled oocyst cutaway showing four slender sporozoites, NO internal sporocysts. Opaque cream wall, muted teal inner structures.
details.cyc: One round mature oocyst cutaway with TWO oval sporocysts, each containing TWO sporozoites, discrete correct organization not many arbitrary circles.
details.cys: One elongated oval mature oocyst cutaway with TWO sporocysts, each containing FOUR slender sporozoites. Not a round cyst full of random nuclei.
details.tva: One pear-shaped trophozoite with a single nucleus, four anterior flagella, one recurrent flagellum forming an undulating membrane along side, and projecting posterior axostyle. No cyst form, no human face.
details.lei: A single macrophage cutaway holding several small intracellular amastigotes, each with a tiny nucleus and kinetoplast, no external flagella on amastigotes.
details.tcr: One C/U-shaped blood trypomastigote with a prominent posterior kinetoplast, central nucleus, coherent undulating membrane and single free anterior flagellum. No RBC crowd behind.
details.tbr: One long slender wavy blood trypomastigote with a central nucleus, posterior kinetoplast, attached undulating membrane and one free anterior flagellum. Organism only.
details.sst: One slim curved rhabditiform larva with short buccal cavity and conspicuous genital primordium represented as two restrained internal structures. No life-cycle panel.
details.alu: One oval fertilized egg with thick rough mammillated shell and one opaque central embryo. No full worm required; egg itself fills central frame with margin.
details.eve: One asymmetrical oval egg with ONE distinctly flattened side and visible coiled larva inside. Not a symmetrical spherical cyst.
details.ttr: One barrel/lemon-shaped egg with thick shell and clear bipolar plugs at BOTH ends. Tan/ochre matte fill, no attached limb-like filaments.
details.hoo: One thin smooth-shelled oval hookworm egg with several blastomere cells enclosed inside, no external spines or decorative dots.
details.sch: One ovoid Schistosoma mansoni-type egg with a clear prominent lateral spine and enclosed miracidium. This is one representative genus form, do not combine terminal and lateral spines.
details.csi: One small ovoid operculated egg with evident opercular shoulders at one end and a small abopercular knob at the other. Ochre bounded shadow.
details.pwe: One thick-shelled yellow-brown operculated oval egg with a distinct operculum, sober simplified shape and central embryo.
details.fhe: One large oval thin-shelled operculated egg, tan/yellow-brown with granular embryo inside, no Clonorchis-like opercular shoulders invented.
details.tso: One larval cysticercus: an opaque fluid-filled cyst cutaway with a SINGLE invaginated scolex showing four suckers and hooklets on the rostellum. No adult tapeworm.
details.tsa: One short coherent ribbon-like adult tapeworm segment with an unarmed scolex having four suckers, NOT hooks, followed by a few connected rectangular proglottids.
details.ech: One coherent hydatid cyst cutaway with a few daughter cysts entirely enclosed within the mother cyst; opaque wall, no loose floating bubbles outside.
details.tox: One slender coiled tissue-migrating larva; correct nematode tube body without legs or face. Do NOT show adult worm or fecal egg as human diagnostic form.
details.tri: One coiled thin larva enclosed within a single oval nurse-cell capsule embedded in a short skeletal muscle bundle, restrained correct muscle stripes.
details.ani: One slender cream nematode larva coiled naturally with tapered ends, no legs, mouth-face or tentacles; isolated organism.
details.sca: A dorsal view of one squat oval adult scabies mite with FOUR PAIRS of short legs (eight total), short posterior bristles and small anterior mouthparts. No insect wings, no six-legged insect anatomy.
details.bmi: One red blood cell containing a coherent Maltese-cross tetrad of FOUR pear-shaped parasite bodies meeting centrally. No malaria pigment, no decorative cross outside cell.

viralGroups: One enveloped herpesvirus particle with a solid matte outer lipid membrane, attached short glycoprotein spikes, tegument and a clearly icosahedral capsid shown in a limited cutaway. A plain coiled dsDNA strand sits within capsid. No spikes extending from the capsid as if it were coronavirus.

One NONENVELOPED icosahedral virus capsid with a restrained tiled capsomere surface, no lipid outer membrane, no long spike crown or cell-like organelles. Small cutaway may show the recorded genome, without a textbook-style DNA double-helix if its genome is single-stranded RNA.

One spherical enveloped virion with a low, close-fitting tiled envelope-protein surface; no giant coronavirus crown. A limited cutaway shows one RNA strand inside a simple capsid. Clean matte geometry, no external loose molecules.

One slightly pleomorphic enveloped respiratory virion with short attached glycoprotein projections and one helical ribonucleoprotein coil in limited cutaway. No multiple influenza-like discrete genome segments.
One enveloped round/pleomorphic virion with attached low glycoprotein projections and exactly THREE separate ribonucleoprotein genome coils shown inside a limited cutaway.
One enveloped round HIV virion with attached short glycoprotein trimers and a clearly CONICAL central capsid shown in limited cutaway, holding two RNA strands. No icosahedral central nucleus.

One enveloped round retrovirus virion with short attached glycoprotein projections and a central condensed capsid in limited cutaway holding two RNA strands. Do not use the characteristic HIV conical capsid as an obligatory HTLV structure.
One NONENVELOPED icosahedral capsid with a few slender fibers attached exactly at capsid vertices, ending in small knobs. No spherical lipid envelope or uniform corona spike crown.

One spherical enveloped HBV Dane particle with a smooth close-fitting surface and a small icosahedral core capsid shown within limited cutaway; restrained circular genome representation, no barcode or letters.
One representative NONENVELOPED fecal HEV particle: compact icosahedral capsid, no outer lipid envelope or decorative corona. Single RNA strand only if limited cutaway is used.

One influenza enveloped virion in a limited cutaway with EXACTLY EIGHT distinct ribonucleoprotein genome segments inside, several short attached surface glycoproteins and matte blue/ochre palette; no floating segments outside.
One spherical enveloped coronavirus particle with attached outward club-shaped spike trimers. Limited cutaway shows one long positive RNA nucleoprotein strand, no influenza eight-segment bundle.
One round enveloped particle with attached short surface glycoprotein projections and a simple central capsid with one RNA strand in limited cutaway. Matte muted violet/terracotta.
One NONENVELOPED wheel-like spherical capsid with THREE concentric capsid layers visibly organized in a small cutaway. Segmented genome is contained inside. No outer lipid envelope.
One NONENVELOPED rounded icosahedral capsid with characteristic shallow cup-like surface depressions, low clean texture, no outer lipid bilayer or spike crown.

One unmistakably BULLET-shaped enveloped virion with a rounded tip and relatively flat base; show coherent helical ribonucleoprotein core in a limited longitudinal cutaway. Attached short spikes, no eyes or gun imagery.

One small round particle coated by HBV-derived surface envelope and with a single circular RNA/delta-antigen ribonucleoprotein core shown in limited cutaway. No icosahedral HBV core incorrectly added.
One large rounded BRICK-shaped complex poxvirus particle, short surface ridges, with a limited cutaway showing a dumbbell-shaped core and lateral bodies. No spherical coronavirus shape.
One spherical enveloped alphavirus with an organized geometric glycoprotein surface and icosahedral internal capsid shown in limited cutaway, one RNA strand contained inside.
